description: The cheapest offers for a whole monthly workload, ranked by monthly cost in USD: give a preset (a typical job; see list_workload_presets) and/or your own tokens a month. Best offer of each model; free promos and batch/flex/priority/regional prices left out unless asked. Each row: monthly_cost_usd, prices, context, checked_at, card_url and a ready cite line.

include_special.description: also batch, flex, priority, regional prices (default false)

input_modality.description: the model must accept this input, e.g. image

one_per_model.description: only the best offer of each model (default true)

preset.description: chatbot | coding_agent | rag | summarization | long_context | vision | embedding_index | trial - fills tokens, min_context, category; your own values win

query.description: only models or providers matching these words, e.g. claude

tools.description: the model must support tool/function calling

name: cheapest_for_workload
